* The character may add 1 to a Force drain and still be power +3 in a battle that same turn.
* The last sentence means that this Effect makes itself lost if the character is not carrying at least one lightsaber.
* A lightsaber carried by a character who cannot use it is inactive. An inactive lightsaber does not allow [[Lightsaber Proficiency]] to deploy, nor does it prevent [[Lightsaber Proficiency]]'s last sentence from making itself lost.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-lightsaberproficiency-PC-Errata-2018-E-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Lightsaber Proficiency (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): Same words as the previous version. This is a full card image again (350 × 490 pixels), with the white italic “E” in the black lower border.

The 2017 slip and the same area of the 2018 E card, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
